recognize_zh: 兩片卵圓形核葉分開排列，細胞質內滿是大而圓、帶折光感的橘紅色顆粒，細胞質基底略帶淡藍，是成熟嗜酸性球（eosinophil）。
features: Granulocyte slightly larger than surrounding red cells
Bilobed nucleus with two oval lobes and condensed chromatin
Abundant coarse, round, refractile orange-red granules filling the cytoplasm
Faintly basophilic cytoplasmic background visible between granules at the periphery
Background red cells include several elongated/oval forms
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high magnification shows a granulocyte with a bilobed nucleus composed of two oval lobes with condensed chromatin. The cytoplasm is filled with coarse, round, refractile orange-red granules set in a faintly basophilic background, and the granules do not obscure the nucleus. Adjacent red cells include several oval forms. Findings are consistent with a mature eosinophil.

ddx.vs: Basophil granules are dark purple-black, irregular in size and typically obscure the nucleus.
Eosinophilic myelocytes have a single round nucleus without lobation and may contain some darker immature granules.
Toxic neutrophils have a multilobed nucleus and dark purple granules in pale pink cytoplasm, not refractile orange granules.
